question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: because

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning and use of the given words. 
 
 
• Moreover is used for adding another fact also; in addition.
 
• **However** is used for adding a comment to what you have just said; in place of although something is true.
 
• Because is used before giving a short reason or explanation, especially when you think the reason or explanation is obvious.
 
• **Therefore** is used to draw a conclusion after proving something.
 
 

 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: **"This is uncommon for HKV as it is a well-known retail district in Delhi."**
 
• "**Because**" is a conjunction and we know conjunctions can be used to give more information, give alternatives, give reasons, give results or give unexpected information.
 
• So, as per the uses of the given words 'because' is the most appropriate word.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete passage: *On Hauz Khas Road, at the entrance to the pedestrianised Hauz Khas Village, the guard (1) at __the barrier asks you to halt and directs __(2) you__ to the parking lot. It's 5 p.m. and the parking lot is nearly empty as shops are closed and there are __(3) hardly__ any shoppers. There aren't many people on the lane leading to the __(4) residential__ area either. This is unusual for HKV (as it is popularly known) __**(5) because **__it is one of Delhi's popular shopping areas. Initially a hub for designer (6)_______, the HKV experience (7)_______ a throbbing mix of cafes, art galleries, curio shops, gyms and, of course, fashion boutiques. The quirky neighbourhood was a hit (8)________ with youngsters and tourists for its happening nightlife. These days however, night comes hours (9)_______ dusk at HKV as you can only see street dogs, security guards, a few takeaway joint managers and bored attendants (10)________ to reach home early.*
